dct_description_sm: Snow samples were collected on Canadian Arctic ice caps, the Greenland Ice Sheet and the Arctic Ocean sea ice to document pollen deposition in the Arctic. This study is part of a larger endeavour to quantify present levels and rates of accumulation of natural (pollen, dust) and anthropogenic (mjor ions, trace metals including mercury) pollutants in snow from the circumpolar Arctic. This research is a contribution to the International Polar Year project: Environmental Change in the High Arctic from Snow and Ice Cores.
dct_title_s: Pollen deposition on Arctic ice caps
